messages:
sara: Heads-up: intake for kaleido-13b (community release) — need prioritization & bring-up checklist. TL;DR: likely quantization needed, target latency 120ms/token, primary workload: assisted search reranking. @liam @ana
liam: On it. Can you drop model artifact link + reproducible eval harness?
sara: artifact: gs://models/kaleido/kaleido-13b/2026-03-19/checkpoint.tar.gz
eval harness: https://github.com/redwood/evals/tree/kaleido-integration
quick perf note: FP16 baseline looks okay on A100: ~160ms for seq=512 (single-stream).
ana: Quick ask: what's our gating? quality delta threshold? cost target?
sara: Proposed gating:
```
- Perplexity <= baseline + 1.5
- Rouge/F1 on NQ-style subset within -2 pts
- Instruction-eval pass rate >= 92% (our instruction-suite)
- Latency <= 130ms/token after quant + batching
```
mike: We should add hallucination checks for retrieval-augmented prompts. Also please keep a 50-example prompt suite for regression tests.
eva: :thumbsup: I'll own quant runs (Q8 + GPTQ candidates). Plan: static PTQ + one GPTQ sweep, compare perplexity + instr-eval. ETA ~3 days.
liam: I'll own infra & canary: allocating 2x8xA10 reserved for initial runs. Need to add a canary route in Dedicated and a fallback policy.
onboard-bot: Intake created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/INT-2026-47 — please assign owners and set priority.
ana: Priority proposal: P2 (aligned to search-2.1 roadmap). Scoring suggestion: Business impact 3, Risk 2, Effort 4 => total 9/15. Notes: moderate infra cost but high product fit.
sara: Agree with P2. Follow-ups: can someone run a quick tokenization sanity check (special tokens, vocab mismatch) and an embeddings drift test vs. current embed model?
liam: Will run tokenization & embed drift. Scheduling a 30-min triage review Friday to look at quant results and instruction-eval. If quant increases latency >15% vs FP16, fallback = serve FP16 smaller variant or use cached embeddings path.
sara: Thanks — I'll update the intake with owners, gating, and the regression prompt suite. Ping here when quant results are in.
